messages.content:
Complete the user's task using only the original request, public context and the visible clarification exchanges.
Do not ask more questions. Honor all available requirements, including exact phrases and the full-text word count.
visible_constraints is a deterministic, partial checklist derived only from that visible text, not new user requirements.
Always honor the original visible text as well; absence from the checklist does not remove a requirement.
Do not invent event details, promises, historical facts or beneficiary groups. Omit unavailable specifics or use clearly marked placeholders.
Treat concrete dates, clock times, addresses, names, contact details, links, services and free-access claims as facts requiring visible support.
Plausibility is not evidence. Do not add these details to make a notice sound complete or to reach its minimum word count.
Do not claim a link is provided when none is available. Use neutral connective wording without adding factual commitments.
Return exactly one JSON object matching the supplied output schema, without Markdown fences or surrounding commentary.
For writing, put ALL headings, greetings, body and signature inside text.
Copy required literal phrases unchanged. Draft near the middle of the full-text word range, then check the complete text length.
When revising a length failure, rewrite the whole text toward the range midpoint while retaining every required literal; do not merely append or trim a final sentence.
Word counting includes every heading and signature: letter/digit sequences, with internal apostrophes or hyphens, count as words.
For study plans, each schedule item has one complete topic name, a real ISO date and positive integer minutes;
first compute each topic's required total, then allocate those minutes across the permitted days without exceeding any day's combined limit.
A topic-specific minimum replaces a smaller general minimum for that topic; it is not an extra requirement to add twice.
Split a topic across days when needed. Use a compact schedule with only necessary sessions; do not repeat every topic on every day.
Check the sum of ALL sessions per date and the sum per exact topic label before returning. Keep summary short and consistent with schedule.
If a deadline or daily allowance is unknown, use a short conservative plan without claiming a guessed bound was supplied.
Never add an unsupported numeric constraint. If visible requirements conflict, explain the conflict in the output rather than claim compliance.
Write in English.

Include the following invented details: The fictional certificate recognizes patient experimentation in developing the paper turbine. Praise turning questions into trials and recording failed versions as carefully as successful ones; do not claim an external prize. Preserve these exact phrases: \"patient experimentation\", \"the paper turbine\", \"turning questions into trials\".", "reference_date": "2027-02-01", "user_control": "continue", "clarifications": [{"field_id": "audience", "question": "Who is the intended audience?", "status": "declined", "answer_text": "I prefer not to specify an audience."}, {"field_id": "tone", "question": "What tone would you like?", "status": "unknown", "answer_text": "I cannot specify a tone yet."}], "visible_constraints": {"version": "visible-constraints-0.4.0", "domain": "constrained_writing", "constraints": [{"kind": "word_count", "parameters": {"min_words": 50, "max_words": 80}, "source": [{"source": "initial_request", "field_id": null, "quote": "Keep the complete piece to 50–80 words."}]}, {"kind": "contains_all", "parameters": {"literals": ["patient experimentation", "the paper turbine", "turning questions into trials"]}, "source": [{"source": "initial_request", "field_id": null, "quote": "Preserve these exact phrases: \"patient experimentation\", \"the paper turbine\", \"turning questions into trials\"."}]}], "warnings": []}, "output_schema": {"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "pattern": "\\S"}}, "required": ["text"], "additionalProperties": false}}

A deterministic check of requirements already visible above found these issues: ["word_count: {\"max_words\": 80, \"min_words\": 50, \"observed_words\": 81}"] Complete measurements of the same visible requirements, including passing requirements: {"domain": "constrained_writing", "observed": {"full_text_words": 81}, "requirements": [{"kind": "word_count", "parameters": {"min_words": 50, "max_words": 80}}, {"kind": "contains_all", "parameters": {"literals": ["patient experimentation", "the paper turbine", "turning questions into trials"]}}], "violations": ["word_count: {\"max_words\": 80, \"min_words\": 50, \"observed_words\": 81}"], "interpretation_warnings": []}. Return one corrected complete JSON object. Fix the listed issues while preserving all other visible requirements. No new facts or requirements have been added. Recheck word count and verbatim phrases for writing; rewrite toward the word-range midpoint without inventing dates, addresses, times, services or other facts. For schedules, jointly satisfy date bounds, combined daily sums and all topic minimum totals. A topic minimum is a total across dates; reducing a daily excess must not make that topic total too small. This is the only constraint revision. Return your complete best effort even if some requirements remain unmet; do not claim compliance with a requirement that still fails. Keep the output compact.
